Run equity research on a stock with Claude's plug-in
A poster ran all nine commands of Claude's equity research plug-in on a stock they were researching, testing it as a financial analyst-style tool.
·
Nov 18, 2026
More AI trading agents
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
The poster, an equity research analyst, tested Claude’s equity research plug-in on a stock they were already researching by running all nine available commands. In the Reddit post they call out the sector report, thesis tracker, catalyst calendar, and screener as especially strong, and frame the tool as producing analyst-style outputs while leaving actual investment judgment to a person.
How it went
They say the overall output was very impressive and argue Claude could replace a junior analyst, while still saying human judgment is needed for real investment decisions. In comments, other finance users pushed back that Claude-assisted work can still need significant rework and cleanup.
Worth knowing
The post itself gives no cost, time, or performance figures; the main catch stated is that human judgment is still required for real-world investing.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Using the equity research plug-in, run every available command on [ticker or company name], including [list commands if you know them, or say all of them]. When you finish, give me a single summary with the bull case, bear case, key risks, valuation takeaways, and any claims you couldn't verify from sources. Mark clearly where the data may be outdated or missing.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/claude/comments/1xz1pk3/can_claude_do_a_financial_analysts_job
